items.html: Afterward Netzah and Hod reigned, and they needed to come reign in their place, in the vessel fit for them. But they did not find their place vacant, since the light of Gevura had descended there, as above. Therefore Bina had to expand through her line, which is the left side, to the place that was later to be the true place of Gevura, after the correction — for at that time they were all one atop another. Then, when the light of Gevura saw that a phase of vessel already existed in its place, it rose to its place, and its vessel, as its light distanced from it, also distanced and descended to the Yesod of Beria. Then Netzah and Hod descended to their true place and reigned there in their vessel, and it broke. Then their light rose up to Gevura, for Hod rose there, since it, too, is of the left line, and then Netzah also rose with it there, for Netzah and Hod are two halves of a single body, as above, and their vessel descended into Netzah and Hod of Beria.
